page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-288 is a high-density general-purpose virtual machine designed for massive parallel compute and memory-intensive enterprise tasks. The instance is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 6985P-C processors based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. The configuration allocates 144 physical cores with 2 threads per core to deliver 288 vCPUs, supported by a combined 504 MB of L3 cache. It includes 1080 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, requiring persistence to be managed entirely via attached network block storage.

Benchmark evaluation demonstrates extreme parallel throughput across multi-threaded applications. The instance achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core testing, PassMark CPU evaluation, and Clang compilation tasks. Memory subsystems exhibit top-tier bandwidth, exceeding 1062 GB/sec in large uncached block reads and 427 GB/sec in uncached block writes. In-memory data throughput is equally robust, reaching over 406 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations and top-tier PassMark database operation scores. Conversely, single-core execution reflects baseline Xeon clock speeds, recording average scores in stress-ng single-core tests.

Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which assist dense matrix multiplication and quantized integer operations. This capability is reflected in top-tier prompt processing speeds during medium-scale LLM inference benchmarks, despite modest token generation rates on unaccelerated CPU architectures.

From an operational cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-standard-288 consolidates massive CPU and memory scale into a single virtualized environment, minimizing the management overhead of multi-node clusters. The instance fits large-scale compilation pipelines, enterprise in-memory databases, continuous integration infrastructures, complex data analytics, and high-throughput static web serving.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-288 is a general-purpose cloud instance engineered for massive concurrent workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 6985P-C processors clocked at 2.3 GHz, it features 144 physical cores, 288 dedicated vCPUs, 504 MB of L3 cache, and 1080 GB of memory (3.75 GB per vCPU). The instance does not bundle local storage or GPUs, relying on network storage for data persistence. Benchmark results show top-tier multi-threaded processing, exceptional memory bandwidth, and superior in-memory key-value performance, alongside hardware support for AVX-512 and AMX instructions. Single-thread performance aligns with standard enterprise CPU profiles. Offering extreme resource density within a single node, c4-standard-288 is suitable for enterprise in-memory databases, large Clang build farms, distributed data processing, and large-scale web delivery tiers.
